mapper.update: INSERT INTO base_info (merge_key, average_continuous_service_years_type, average_continuous_service_years_male, average_continuous_service_years_female, average_continuous_service_years, average_age, month_average_predetermined_overtime_hours) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{averageContinuousServiceYearsType}, #{averageContinuousServiceYearsMale}, #{averageContinuousServiceYearsFemale}, #{averageContinuousServiceYears}, #{averageAge}, #{monthAveragePredeterminedOvertimeHours}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO UPDATE SET average_continuous_service_years_type = EXCLUDED.average_continuous_service_years_type, average_continuous_service_years_male = EXCLUDED.average_continuous_service_years_male, average_continuous_service_years_female = EXCLUDED.average_continuous_service_years_female, average_continuous_service_years = EXCLUDED.average_continuous_service_years, average_age = EXCLUDED.average_age, month_average_predetermined_overtime_hours = EXCLUDED.month_average_predetermined_overtime_hours WHERE ( base_info.average_continuous_service_years_type, base_info.average_continuous_service_years_male, base_info.average_continuous_service_years_female, base_info.average_continuous_service_years, base_info.average_age, base_info.month_average_predetermined_overtime_hours ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.average_continuous_service_years_type, EXCLUDED.average_continuous_service_years_male, EXCLUDED.average_continuous_service_years_female, EXCLUDED.average_continuous_service_years, EXCLUDED.average_age, EXCLUDED.month_average_predetermined_overtime_hours )
